title: PhysxDeformableMaterialAPI
summary: PhysX elasticity damping for a volume or surface deformable material, read when PhysxDeformableMaterialAPI is listed in usd-schemas of a deformable material prim or of the material bound to a PhysicsScene (its default deformable materials).
producer_scope: Published like any applied physics API: every declared attribute at its resolved value; a prim carrying this API is in physics scope on its own. No column is rewritten or created by the producer.

columns.name: physxDeformableMaterial:elasticityDamping
columns.absent: 0: no elasticity damping. A negative value is clamped to 0 at parse.
columns.notes: The property update passes a new value to PhysX without the clamp.

interactions.rule: The ovstage walker enumerates deformable materials by OmniPhysicsDeformableMaterialAPI, OmniPhysicsSurfaceDeformableMaterialAPI or OmniPhysicsCurveDeformableMaterialAPI (sic; the schema is OmniPhysicsCurvesDeformableMaterialAPI); the column is read on those prims. The scene's bound material is parsed too, whatever OmniPhysics material APIs it lists.

USD applies this API as a built-in of PhysxSurfaceDeformableMaterialAPI and USD population lists both names; the parser checks each name on its own, so a hand-populated surface material must list PhysxDeformableMaterialAPI for elasticityDamping to be read.
